about.description: Equity-index perpetual on edgeX (Amber Group-incubated) tracking S&P 500 Index (SPX), with pricing referencing Stork decentralized oracle network. Users gain linear exposure to the index level without holding any underlying constituent stocks or futures. Positions are margined and cash-settled in USDC on StarkEx (migrating to EDGE Chain L2).
